activation_condition: the complete 25-pair frozen_initial pilot fails the unchanged preregistered physical authorization gate

motivation_snapshot.interpretation: frozen foot masks address mask drift, but the contact raw sum remains dependent on active-frame and contact-pair counts and can dominate the unchanged regularizers

single_factor_change.coarse_semantic_stage: divide each raw temporal contact sum by the number of positive cropped timing frames and average over valid semantic contact pairs
single_factor_change.fine_region_pre_anchor_stage: divide each raw temporal contact sum by the number of positive cropped timing frames and average over valid fine-region pairs
single_factor_change.fine_anchor_stage: mean squared Euclidean distance over positive cropped timing frames and locked one-to-one anchor vertex pairs, then average over valid contact-region pairs
single_factor_change.scientific_label: stabilization ablation; do not claim this candidate is the paper-literal Eq. 4/Eq. 6 reduction

comparisons: active_contact_mean versus identical random_shape_reference for the unchanged full-augmentation authorization gate
active_contact_mean versus frozen_initial paper_literal_raw_sum on the same samples for the single-factor causal contrast

authorization_gate.decision_policy: all unchanged criteria pass; no threshold may be relaxed after observing results

prohibited_changes: changing the foot-contact predicate or mask policy
changing samples, donor shapes, timing, contact regions, seed, optimizer, iteration count or stage boundary
changing penetration, regularization, smoothness, acceleration, skate or ground reductions
using validation/test generator metrics to authorize augmentation
